entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: The prisoner [f 4 3][n]has returned.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Well done. It seems you have[n]remembered my words...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: You truly make it worth[n]rehabilitating you.
What's that mean?
I never asked for this.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Shut your mouth and listen, Inmate!

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: *chuckle* I am not attempting to withhold[n]information from you.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: The essence of the rehabilitation that[n]you must complete will be explained[n]in due time.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Once you encounter allies who share[n]your ideals and discover your place[n]in reality...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: ...Only then, will I explain it all.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Such a day should not be far off.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: This time, I wish to introduce you to[n]the aid we are providing.
What do you mean?
Aid?

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Due to your potential in wielding the[n]power of the wild card, you can handle[n]more than one Persona.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: That power holds infinite possibilities.[n]We will assist you in nurturing that[n]potential.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: ...To that end, we must execute your[n]Persona.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: *chuckle* Do not be alarmed. Personas[n]are personalities that exist within you...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Thus, you will only be discarding old[n]personalities to have them be reborn[n]as new ones.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Discarding a personality means killing[n]a part of oneself. That is why we will be[n]"executing" them.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Some things can only be gained by losing[n]them. This loss will become your flesh,[n]born anew within you.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: You may think of it as a "fusion" of[n]Personas.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: It appears you conveniently have some[n]Personas at hand. Very well. It will be[n]quicker if you observe.
